intent: A footed shuttle blocks the key route and the key blocks the shuttle. The witnessed route parks the key south, moves the shuttle, delivers the key north, then clears the operating stance.

composition.preconditions: One enclosed planar room; default start; one gem; intact independent rigid groups.
composition.preserve: Void and stop cells; verified operating stances and normal walking access.
composition.postconditions: Gem collected in ordinary replay; no promise of tool reuse or unique ordering.
